avoid_for: SaaS product marketing, e-commerce, dashboards, or any context needing imagery, product art, or a single CTA color — with no chromatic accent, no filled CTAs, and no shadows, the system can only carry type-first editorial content.
best_for: Editorial / creative personal portfolios, studio and magazine-style brand sites where type is the entire visual — a warm monochrome broadside register, display-serif headlines, condensed mastheads, paper-to-ink inversions, Pentagram/Rauno Freiberg-adjacent.
name: Henry
palette_voice: One-hundred-percent warm monochrome: Paper (#fafafa) cream ground and Headline Ink (#2a2722) warm near-black, with Sepia (#3e3b36) flanking and hairline/ash/midstone/pebble as neutral borders — no chromatic accent, no product color, no blue link, ever; full-bleed paper and ink sections alternate like a broadsheet; the only surfaces are Paper and Ink, with zero shadows, one 12px radius, and hierarchy delivered purely by scale, weight, and inversion.
signature_moves: Full-bleed Paper/Ink section inversion — cream type on Ink bands and ink type on Paper, flipped like a broadsheet, never gradient-blended
Manuka section mastheads at 226-371px, weight 400, line-height 0.75, uppercase, edge-to-edge — condensed type as the entire section identity
Louize Display headline at 116-132px with an intersecting half-size italic phrase set inside the same baseline (e.g. 'of the' at 35px within 132px type)
Square-cornered monochrome halftone plate as a typographic counterweight to the display headline — no radius, no caption, no color
Brand ticker strip — repeated Louize Display wordmarks on a dark Ink band with 'COMING SOON' ghost tags (12px radius, 1px outline)

source.radius: 12px only — cards, buttons, tags, no square corners, no pills
source.shadow: none — zero elevation tokens, hierarchy via scale, inversion, and 1px hairlines

tagline: Gothic broadside poster on warm cream paper. One hundred percent monochrome, no chromatic accent, all visual intensity carried by display type and full-bleed paper-to-ink inversions.
typographic_voice: Three-type system: a display serif (Louize Display, subst. Fraunces/GT Sectra) sets poetry and editorial prose at 77-132px weight 400; an ultra-condensed sans (Manuka, subst. Druk/Condor) stamps 226-371px section mastheads in one weight, one case, one color at 0.75 leading; and a neo-grotesque (Neue Montreal, subst. Inter) carries all UI at 12-24px with hairline-tight -0.01em tracking — no serif below 32px on long passages, no tracking looser than 1.5 line-height on body.
